title: Vault knowledge, provenance, rights, agents, and human approval
objective: Make project-scoped evidence and policy the authority for agent proposals, rights checks, human decisions, and resulting artifacts.

obligations.title: Knowledge objects are project-scoped, versioned, sourced, permissioned, retained, and reviewable
obligations.residualRisk: Unscoped notes or prompts can leak context and turn unsupported claims into client-facing facts.

obligations.title: Agent runs resolve entitlement, source scope, policy, budget, citations, validation, and human gates before mutation
obligations.residualRisk: An agent can retrieve across projects, exceed budget, cite unsupported claims, or mutate approved work.

obligations.title: Agent retrieval, model, prompt, policy, output, reviewer, rights, and usage are replayable and auditable
obligations.residualRisk: Agent output cannot be defended or reproduced without exact source, policy, model, and decision lineage.

slos.indicator: Accepted agent claims with valid project-authorized evidence spans
Agent mutations without required human approval
